subject: afn
title: AFN.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 381 (NYM-15). AFN (affinity negation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From the subject: CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts). From TH-CONT: STF (source transfer), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and C-CONT (composite continuance). GRAD (gradualism), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", is on a dotted line from TH-CONT. From CUL-TF-S: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and TH-CONT. From GRAD: AFTF (affinity transfer). From AFTF: POST (postulation). PART (participation) is on a dotted line from POST.
